audio_description:
A red power-line runs across an ornate chamber set with a circular sealing emblem.
A tall, sleek Esthar monolith-container rises, bright against the clouds.

context.scene_title: An Esthar sealing facility — a great sorceress-seal emblem and a tall Esthar container (the Sorceress Memorial / Adel's tomb apparatus), Disc 3.
locations: An ornate Esthar interior dominated by a large circular sorceress-sealing emblem (radial web/sunburst), and a tall monolithic Esthar container marked with the Esthar emblem, standing under the sky
context.summary: A red power-line runs across an ornate chamber set with a huge circular sorceress-sealing emblem, then the view reveals a tall, sleek Esthar monolith-container bearing the Esthar logo, mirror-bright against the clouds — the apparatus used to seal a sorceress.
context.context_note: Read as the Esthar Sorceress Memorial / Adel's-tomb sealing apparatus (Disc 3); the sealing emblem and Esthar container support this, but the exact structure is inferred.
